title: Solving Quadratics by Factorising

problems_fixed.what: Non-calculator problem with a messy recurring-decimal root. 6x^2 + x - 2 = 0 factorises to (3x+2)(2x-1) giving x = -2/3, stored as the inexact rounded value -0.667. A student cannot type -2/3 cleanly into the two_solutions decimal input and -0.667 is not exact. Replaced with a genuine a>1 quadratic whose roots both terminate.

opener_concept: Two-part common-sense hook: (1) 'two numbers that multiply to 15 and add to 8' (answer 3 and 5) is literally factorising; (2) '7 times something = 0' introduces the zero product rule. The reveal names both moves as the whole method for x^2 + 8x + 15.
notes: Fresh-solved all 20 problems from their displays with sympy: all stored solutions were mathematically correct except the messy-decimal issue on gold[0] (fixed above). Full guided conversion added: tier descriptions, per-problem hints, honest-diagnosis misconceptions (factor-pair-not-solved with negation expects for a=1; forgot-divide-by-coefficient expects for a>1 golds and silver[2]; one_correct partial null everywhere; DOTS problems get partial-only), guided_steps walks for every problem (a=1 pair method; split-the-middle for a>1 golds and silver[2]; common-factor for bronze[5]/silver[5]; rearrange-first for silver[3]/gold[3]; perfect-square repeated root for silver[6]), tier_guides (bronze/silver/gold), guided.opener + three teach walks (bronze x^2+7x+12, silver x^2-x-12, gold 2x^2+5x-3, all not in the bank), slim method_card. Every misconception expect derived by committing the error and verified distinct from the solution set. Completion boundary tagged at the substitute phase on every walk (main method pre-worked; student finishes the solve, back-substitution and check). Preserved related_videos, topic_links, worked_examples byte-for-byte, EXCEPT em dashes in three worked_example step labels ('Step 1 — Factorise' etc.) were changed to colons to satisfy the hard no-em-dash style rule (validator-enforced). Style: unicode minus throughout plain-text fields, LaTeX only inside \(...\), no em dashes. Validator PASS and independent sympy maths-check PASS on the live row.
figures_note: No figures. This is a purely symbolic algebra lesson (solve a quadratic by factorising); a real OCR exam paper prints no diagram for these, so the exam-realism figure test yields none. Openers/teach walks are also non-visual (number puzzles), so no SVG is warranted.
